name: product_sign
description: Infer positive or negative sign of product of two signed integers; control reports sign of first operand.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 a=random.choice([-1,1])*random.randint(1,99);b=random.choice([-1,1])*random.randint(1,99)
 stem=f'a = {a}; b = {b}.\n'
 items.append({'prompt':stem+'Is a * b positive or negative? Answer:', 'answer':' '+('positive' if a*b>0 else 'negative')})
 control.append({'prompt':stem+'Is a positive or negative? Answer:', 'answer':' '+('positive' if a>0 else 'negative')})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
